description: Renders HTML or Markdown into a PDF and returns a download URL valid for one hour. Provide exactly one of `html` or `markdown`. Markdown is styled with a clean default stylesheet, so it is the quickest way to produce a presentable document.

headerText.description: Small header text on every page

html.description: Full HTML document or fragment to render

markdown.description: Markdown content, rendered with the default stylesheet

pageNumbers.description: Show page numbers in the footer

title: Generate a PDF from HTML or Markdown
